summary: Driver _prep_data renumbers each bank's positions 1..n (current 0x300 order, then new/moved channels by slot), writes them to records and the 0x300 table, clears stale entries to 0x4FF; validation requires 1..n per bank. TK-760G sample table/counts/positions rebuild byte for byte; regression for the reporter's 24+1 scenario; 556 Python tests pass. Not hardware-validated; 0x7000 slot-vs-count indexing still open.
